title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP: AI skill to investigate policy sync and device health
summary: The briefing accurately reports Microsoft's planned diagnostic skill, rollout targets and Security Copilot capacity requirement. The manual device-status controls and licensing figures are documented, while the skill-specific default, controls and consumption rate remain unpublished.
